#263 corridor   44,400 ha  184 km, 84% on named features, 11 legs
  In words: Starting at the northernmost point 5.1430°N 24.3799°E the boundary goes north across open bush about 17 km to an unnamed river and then follows that river south-east about 8 km to meet the toich edge (seasonal water). The line then follows the toich edge east about 11 km to meet primary road at 5.1154°N 24.4620°E, then follows primary road south-east about 14 km to meet Mbomou at 5.0819°N 24.5340°E. From Mbomou the boundary follows Mbomou south-east about 23 km to meet the COD border at 4.9714°N 24.6253°E, then follows the COD border west about 31 km to meet the toich edge (seasonal water) at 5.0157°N 24.3890°E. The line then follows the toich edge west about 23 km to primary road and continues north along the toich edge about 24 km to meet primary road at 5.0614°N 24.3357°E, with about 12 km crossing open bush between primary road points that must be beaconed with the community, and returns north along the toich edge to the start.
